snippet.title: Talented Guy runs 27 yrs Old generation Streetfood Business | Food Setup documentary
snippet.description:
We travel to Bindapur area of New Delhi , India  to cover the food documentary . We have shown the story of Hardworking guy who do Part-time another work of Food Delivery from 3 am to 8:30 am IST.  

The location of this Food Stall is in front of the Bindapur Sewage Pumping Station. This Guy sells only two kind of Items mainly one is Burger and another one known as Tikki and third item is kind of Mix of Burger with the Chickpeas ( modified dish ) . Generally the same Fried Potato dough is used for making Tikki and also for the Burger . He also use the Exhaust fan in summer for prevention of Hot . 

Normal Fried Burger cost - 30₹ INR
Burger with Chickpeas which is modified - 40₹ INR
One Tikki ( Fried Potato dough ) with Chickpeas - 25₹ INR 
Full 2 Tikki with Chickpeas - 35₹ INR 

In India street food is quite cheap , if you are in this area of Delhi you can give a try at this Stall.This food Business was started by his father 27 years and then his elder brother worked here and since 5 years he is working at the stall .

snippet.description:
Happy Biryani Day! 🍚✨ Get ready to embark on an unparalleled culinary journey as we unveil the true essence of Biryani (or Pulao, as it's famously known in Lucknow!). This isn't just a food video; it's a deep dive into the lives and stories of the incredible hands that craft this iconic dish.

Join us as we explore five distinct worlds of Biryani in the heart of Lucknow:

The Comfort of Home: Discover the warmth and traditions behind a classic Ghar ki Biryani.

The Grandeur of Celebrations: Experience the festive magic of Shaadi ki Biryani, prepared for hundreds.

The Legacy of Idrees: Step into the legendary kitchen of Idrees Biryani, a name synonymous with Lucknow's culinary heritage.

The Refinement of a 5-Star: Witness the sophisticated artistry behind Azrak Biryani at a luxurious hotel.

The Street's Delight: Savor the rustic charm and bustling energy of Thela ki Biryani, a true roadside gem.

We've captured the passion, the techniques, and the unique perspectives of the chefs and cooks who breathe life into every grain of rice. From age-old family recipes to professional culinary secrets, this video celebrates the diverse flavors and untold stories of Lucknow's beloved Biryani.

snippet.title: Ep 11, Best ITO Street Food Walk I Sardarji Paratha, Swadeshi Pizza, Moradabadi Dal, Udupi Spa Dosa
snippet.description:
ITO is a bustling hub of administration, commerce, and education in Delhi, recently became the backdrop for our food tour. Accompanied by our physician friend from MAMC, Akshat, we set out to explore the culinary gems of this vibrant neighborhood.  

We began at Yadav Nariyal Pani Bhandar, where we sipped on refreshing ripe coconut water. The young seller told us how the cart has been around for years, with the coconut pulp sold at traffic crossings while the water is served fresh here. It was the perfect start to our journey.  

At Hum Hindustani on Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, we stepped into what felt like a cosy co-working space where one could work while enjoying their favorite food. A true landmark of Ito’s culinary scene, we indulged in a posi dosa and chow chow bhaat. The flavors were bold, comforting, and deliciously authentic.  

On Vishnu Digamber Marg, we stopped for a Swadeshi Pizza for Moong Dal Pizza, essentially a moonglet with pizza toppings. The unique combination of textures and flavors made it a surprisingly delightful experience. We also sampled Muradabad dal here, a comforting yet zesty lentil based dish. 

Next, we tried a slightly different version of dabeli at the Bombay Special Food Stall near ESIC. The aalu masala inside was quite flavourful, setting this version apart from the usual.  

We ended our journey at Sardar Ji Parathe Wale near ITO Metro Gate No. 4. Run by a hardworking and genial Sardarji, the place offered freshly prepared parathas with a variety of curries. We opted for their anda paratha, a hearty creation combining aloo paratha with beaten egg stuffed inside. Watching it being made right in front of us was as enjoyable as eating it.  

This food tour through ITO gave us a taste of its vibrant culinary culture, blending traditional flavors with innovative twists.

Narr.. poor Santosh is making bread in the factory till late night when the set comes to him.

Seth becomes normal and asks.... Santosh, all the goods are ready, right, because the bread packets have to be delivered early tomorrow morning.

Santosh getting tired... yes set... I have prepared all the bread packets.

Natr.. just then there is a sound of lightning in the sky which Santosh hears.

Santosh asks worriedly... set, is it raining outside? How loudly is the lightning flashing?

Seth Nirmal... yes, the weather is bad outside. You leave for home quickly and take this, your daily wages for today and this ₹50 extra for your overtime.

Narr.  ₹50 for the factory set might have been a small amount but for Santosh, who was a poor bread earner, ₹50 was very valuable at that time because the condition of his house was very bad due to the rains and he had to run his family at any cost.

Santosh happily says /...Thank you very much Seth, I am leaving.

Narr.=Seth gives him a packet of bread.

Set Nirmal...Take this packet of bread too, your children will eat it.

Narr.. As soon as he comes out of the factory with bread and money, it is rainy weather and there is heavy lightning.

Santosh worries..Today it is such a rainy weather, it will rain very heavily, I should leave for home quickly, otherwise if I get drenched in the rain, these breads will also get spoiled.

Narrtion..Santosh starts moving towards home quickly, then it starts raining very hard and a storm starts hitting the stove.  Rita, sitting in front, was looking towards the door again and again with the hope of ration being brought. Paras, writhing with hunger, asks for food.

Paras crying... Mummy, Mummy, I am very hungry, my stomach is also aching, please give me something to eat, huhu huh.

Khushi... crying... Yes Mummy, if you have rotis from last night, then give it to me with salt and oil, we will eat.

Narr... Seeing both the children writhing with hunger and asking for dry roti, the poor daughter-in-law's heart almost breaks because the other days they used to show tantrums in eating dal rice, now both were ready to eat dry roti because the family had not cooked food for the whole day.. Just then, Santosh, drenched in rain, comes inside with little ration in a bag.


Paras happily says, Mummy, Mummy, look, Papa has come with the ration, cook food quickly.

Santosh gives the ration, take this, Rita, I have brought ration for two times, today the owner has given me ₹50 extra for overtime, so I have brought a packet of milk, please make some tea.

Rita, I will make it now.

Shanti cares, daughter-in-law, leave everything, first ask about his head and apply oil, see, he has come completely drenched in the rain, the rains of Sawan and Bhado are very bad, if it catches cold fever, it does not go away easily.

Nat.  Rita brings a towel and quickly dries Santosh's head and applies mustard oil. Then both the children stare at the bread packet with hungry eyes.

Tears in Paras' eyes.. Mummy, Mummy, are you very hungry? Should I take out one bread from the packet and eat it?

Mother-in-law gets emotional.. Oh my dear grandson, take not one but two breads and eat them. You are hungry.. right?

Paras gets happy.. Okay grandma..., here Khushi Didi, you also eat bread, you have not eaten anything either.

Nart.. Paras takes two breads for himself and gives it to his sister as well. Although everyone was hungry, both the children start eating the bread by folding it. Shanti's eyes fill up.

Shanti cries.. Will this bread fill the stomach of both of you? Nibha go daughter, put the dal bhaat to cook.. See how both are eating the bread by cutting it.. Neither of them has eaten a grain of food since morning. If you eat too much refined flour, it will harm your stomach. 

Narr... Nibha quickly comes to the kitchen where the lack of living in poverty was clearly visible in the empty ration boxes. While on one hand the rich eat good food in the rainy season, the same rain makes the poor family dependent even for two meals a day... Due to less ration, Nibha cooks half rice and a handful of dal.

Nibha...helplessly asks, mother what vegetables should I cut. There is no vegetable at all.

Rita...helplessly... Nibha see, there must be two-four potatoes

snippet.title: Nehlle Pe Dehlla 4K Full Movie | Saif Ali Khan & Bipasha Basu | Sanjay Dutt & Kim Sharma | Comedy
snippet.description:
Nehlle Pe Dehlla is a hilarious Bollywood thriller comedy film that was released in 2007. This film has been directed by Ajay Chandhok and the catchy dialogues have been written by Rumi Jaffrey. Sanjay Dutt, Saif Ali Khan, Bipasha Basu have lead roles in the film.


नेहले पे देहला बॉलीवुड की जबरदस्त थ्रिलर कॉमेडी फिल्म है, जिसे 2007  में रिलीज किया गया था। इस फिल्म को डायरेक्टर अजय चन्दोक ने किया है और कैची डायलॉग रूमी जाफ़री ने लिखा है। फिल्म में संजय दत्त, सैफ अली खान, बिपाशा बासु का लीड रोल है। 

कहानी दो चोर जिम्मी (सैफ अली खान) और जॉनी (संजय दत्त ) अमीर बनने का सपना देखते हैं और एक होटल मैनेजर   बलराम साहनी (शक्ति कपूर ) को ब्लैकमेल करने का फैसला करते हैं, जो अपने ही होटल से पैसे चुराता है। किसी और से पहले - अकाउंट्स, फाइनेंस डिपार्टमेंट, यहां तक   कि सीसीटीवी भी - जिम्मी और जॉनी इसका पता लगा लेते हैं और उसी होटल में वेटर के भेष में वहां काम करके बलराम को ब्लैकमेल करने का फैसला करते हैं। जब तक वो जिम्मी और जॉनी अपने काम को अज़ाम देते उससे पहले ही बलराम की हत्या हो जाती है। 

अब, जिमी और जॉनी को सबको यह दिखाना है कि बलराम ज़िंदा है, ताकि वे अपना पैसा पा सकें। इसलिए, वे एक मृत शरीर से हर संभव काम करवाते हैं जो आपकी कल्पना से परे है। लाश संगीत पर नाचती है, कार चलाती है, अपने बैंक को ऑपरेट भी करता है..भला मरा हुआ आदमी से जिम्मी और जॉनी ये सारे काम कैसे करवाते है? ये जानने के लिए देखिय़े जबरदस्त कॉमेडी से भरपूर फिल्म 'नेहले पे देहला'

अब, जिमी और जॉनी को सबको यह दिखाना है कि बलराम ज़िंदा है, ताकि वे अपना पैसा पा सकें। इसलिए, वे एक मृत शरीर से हर संभव काम करवाते हैं जो आपकी कल्पना से परे है। लाश संगीत पर नाचती है, कार चलाती है, अपने बैंक को ऑपरेट भी करता है..भला मरा हुआ आदमी से जिम्मी और जॉनी ये सारे काम कैसे करवाते है? ये जानने के लिए देखिय़े जबरदस्त कॉमेडी से भरपूर फिल्म 'नेहले पे देहला'
